context: Two teens debrief a chaotic school chorus practice
purpose: Teach: いまさら/それどころか/またもや/しゃべる/親しみ/スルー/巻い/歌声

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日の合唱練、めっちゃキツくなかった?
lines.en: Today's chorus practice was brutal, wasn't it?
lines.style: Tired teen sigh, walking home pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで。声出しすぎて、喉に絆創膏巻いて休みたいレベル。
lines.en: Seriously. I'm so blown out I'd wrap a bandage on my throat and rest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しかも先生、同じ箇所をまたもや指摘してきてさ。
lines.en: And the teacher pointed out the same spot, yet again.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先輩たちの歌声、近くで聞くと別格だな。親しみある優しい音で。
lines.en: Hearing the seniors up close, their voices are in a different league. Warm, approachable sound.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかる。いまさら焦って自主練しても間に合わなくない?
lines.en: I know. Cramming solo practice this late won't really help, right?

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それどころか、明日の数学のテストも全然手つかずだぜ。
lines.en: More than that, I haven't even touched tomorrow's math test prep.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ふぁ、しゃべるエネルギーすら残ってない。今日はLINEもスルーで早く寝る。
lines.en: Ugh, I don't even have energy to talk. Tonight I'm ignoring LINE and going straight to bed.
lines.style: Yawning teen girl, voice trailing off.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 了解。明日朝、駅で集合な。お互いゾンビでも来いよ。
lines.en: Got it. Tomorrow morning, meet at the station. Show up even as zombies.
lines.style: Casual teen-boy sign-off, raising a fist weakly.
